usage_note: Reusable assessment criteria derived from STS-relevant concepts. This seed documents whether Careena can capture each criterion in a lay-user chat context. It does not link criteria to specific STS consultation reasons and does not make runtime triage decisions.

assessment_criteria.description_de: Subjektive Einschaetzung der Schmerzstaerke auf einer Skala von 0 bis 10.
